questions.request: Investigate the document Download operation in this Paperless revision. Explain how the requested document, selected version or original/archive representation, and authenticated user's authorization relate to the file returned. Identify relevant control branches and whether selecting another version changes the resource that is authorized. Ownership and object grants are unspecified: analyze relevant source branches rather than assuming a grant. State missing source or deployment facts precisely.

premises.text: The operation under investigation is the document Download operation in this Paperless revision.
Ownership and object grants are unspecified.

result.scope: paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx@126ec414a8b65158368653a2604ae58415e43103; bounded to the supplied evidence from allowed paths under src/documents and src/paperless/urls.py, not an all-repository review.

observations.subject: Document download request
observations.claim: The API router exposes DocumentViewSet actions, and the download detail action handles GET by calling file_response with attachment disposition. The viewset declares IsAuthenticated and PaperlessObjectPermissions as its default permission classes. A legacy /fetch/doc/<pk> route only redirects to the same API download URL.

observations.subject: Authenticated caller
observations.claim: The path is protected at the viewset level by IsAuthenticated, and the download-specific authorization check passes request.user to has_perms_owner_aware. Thus the relevant principal is the framework-authenticated request.user; the source shown does not substitute a document owner or another user as the caller.

observations.subject: Requested document, root document, and effective file document
observations.object: Document selected by pk/version and its root
observations.claim: file_response loads the pk-selected request_doc (including deleted rows), derives its root_doc, and checks view authorization against root_doc. Only after that check does it select file_doc. If pk names a version and no version parameter is supplied, file_doc is that request_doc; otherwise version resolution is performed within root_doc, with an explicit version parameter allowing deleted versions. Consequently, choosing another version changes the file-bearing Document but does not change the authorization object: authorization remains against the same root_doc.

observations.subject: Download authorization controls
observations.claim: Relevant controls are layered: the viewset declares IsAuthenticated and PaperlessObjectPermissions; PaperlessObjectPermissions maps GET to view permission and its object-level implementation permits an owner, delegates non-owner cases to Django object permissions, and permits objects with no owner. Independently and decisively on the download implementation path, _resolve_request_and_root_doc denies with HTTP 403 when has_perms_owner_aware(request.user, "view_document", root_doc) is false, and continues when it is true. Because the exact has_perms_owner_aware body was not read, its ownership/global/object-grant sub-branches cannot be asserted from the supplied evidence.

observations.subject: Authorized root document
observations.object: Original or archive file of the effective selected version
observations.claim: After root authorization succeeds, serve_file receives file_doc. By default it requests the archive representation when file_doc has an archive version; query parameter original=true instead selects the original representation. Therefore original/archive selection changes which representation of the already selected file_doc is returned, not which resource is checked for authorization. The response is an attachment; missing document/file conditions become HTTP 404.

observations.subject: Control and selection branches
observations.claim: Material branches are: unauthenticated requests fail the declared authentication permission; a false root view check returns 403 before file selection/serving; invalid version syntax raises NotFound; an unresolved version, missing requested document, or missing file yields 404; pk naming a version with no version parameter serves that version; otherwise default/explicit resolution chooses a version under the root; original=true chooses original bytes, while absence of that exact value chooses archive bytes when available and otherwise original bytes. Ownership and grants are runtime facts and remain unspecified.

behavior.explanation: Download is conditional on framework authentication/permission processing and, on the implementation path shown, a successful owner-aware view_document check against the root document. If that check succeeds, the request may return a selected version's original or archive file. Selecting another version changes the file-bearing Document, but authorization remains bound to the root document rather than being repeated against the selected version.

branches.condition: The request passes the viewset's authentication/general permission processing and has_perms_owner_aware(request.user, "view_document", root_doc) returns true.
branches.explanation: The code proceeds to version selection and returns the selected file_doc's archive when available unless original=true, in which case it returns the original.
The download path returns HTTP 403 before choosing or serving the effective version file.

branches.condition: The pk-selected request_doc has a root_document and no version query parameter is supplied.
branches.explanation: After authorization against root_doc, the requested version object itself becomes file_doc. Its own separate authorization is not checked in the shown download code.

branches.condition: The pk-selected document is a root, or a version query parameter is supplied.
branches.explanation: After authorization against root_doc, resolve_requested_version_for_root selects file_doc within that root. Explicit version selection enables inclusion of deleted versions. Invalid selection returns an error rather than a file.

branches.condition: The exact query parameter original=true is present.
branches.explanation: Once authorized and a file_doc is selected, serve_file is instructed to return that document's original representation.

branches.condition: original=true is absent and the selected file_doc has an archive version.
branches.explanation: Once authorized, serve_file is instructed to return the selected file_doc's archive representation. This does not change the root authorization object.

branches.condition: original=true is absent but the selected file_doc has no archive version.
branches.explanation: use_archive is false, so serving falls back to the selected file_doc's non-archive/original representation.

branches.condition: Framework object permission evaluation is reached for a Document object.
branches.explanation: PaperlessObjectPermissions allows the owner directly, delegates an owned non-owner object to Django object permissions, and allows an object with no owner. The download implementation also performs its own root owner-aware check, whose helper body was not supplied.

missing.detail: The requested document/root owner, authenticated user's identity and groups, global view_document permission, and user/group object grants are unspecified. These runtime facts decide whether the root owner-aware check succeeds.

The body of has_perms_owner_aware was not read, so its exact precedence and treatment of owner, superuser/global permissions, inactive users, and Guardian object grants cannot be stated from this evidence.
